caption: The drawing features a dress, predominantly shaded in a light pink color, displayed from the back. The dress has short, puffed sleeves with decorative black loops at the sleeve edges and along the neckline, which is rounded and slightly scooped with a small bow drawn at the center back. The waistline is cinched with a black-looped trim, and the skirt is full and knee-length with two horizontal bands of the same black decorative loops around its lower portion. Beneath the hem of the pink dress, two white undergarment legs with scalloped edges extend downward. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, sketch-like outline of the dress, showing the general shape and construction details in plain linework without color or decorative elements. The background is a light beige, and the overall style is that of a fashion illustration.
title: Boy's Dress
